mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate, as measured by the 3-month moving average, compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that dampens corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and rise in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a strong labor market and consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through improved corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE falling and RSAFS rising fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative coefficient.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth GDP regime (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%), rising housing starts (HOUST) signal robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rising in high-GDP regimes fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the average return in such regimes is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to inflationary pressures and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates stagflationary pressures, which drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced corporate margins and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO falling and CPIAUCSL rising fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a positive coefficient.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production regime (INDPRO > 115.0), robust manufacturing output signals strong economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 115.0 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the average return in such regimes is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
